exercises.name: Warm-Up: Jump Rope or Fast March in Place
exercises.notes: Build light sweat, stay relaxed, nasal breathing if possible

exercises.name: Dynamic Mobility Circuit
exercises.notes: World’s greatest stretch, squat-to-stand, hip circles, arm circles, thoracic rotations

exercises.name: Pogo Jumps
exercises.notes: Quick off the floor, stiff ankles, quiet landings

exercises.name: Skater Jumps
exercises.notes: Stick the landing briefly, control knee position, jump laterally with intent

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: Leave 2 reps in reserve, body straight, full range, stop before form breaks

exercises.name: Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
exercises.notes: Use bed, couch, or chair if available, upright torso, slow lower

exercises.name: 1a. Table Row or Sturdy Desk Row
exercises.notes: Primary back exercise, keep chest up, pull elbows toward hips, use safe sturdy setup only

exercises.name: 1b. Side Plank
exercises.notes: Straight line from head to heel, squeeze glutes, do not let hips sag

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.notes: Drive through heel, pause at top for 1 second, keep ribs down

exercises.name: Reverse Crunch
exercises.notes: Curl pelvis up, slow eccentric, avoid swinging legs

exercises.name: Prone Neck Hold
exercises.notes: Light effort, chin tucked, no pain, keep neck long

exercises.name: Supine Neck Hold
exercises.notes: Light effort, chin tucked, no pain, do not strain

exercises.name: Shadow Boxing Tempo Intervals
exercises.notes: Moderate pace, stay sharp and relaxed, focus on footwork and breathing
